sn17.6:1.3: The phrasing here is odd, but the regular syntax in the two phrases (object in accusative, subject in nominative, verb in imperative) suggests it is not corrupt. I think the Buddha is quoting a saying, a kind of curse, then he substitutes the Dhammic meaning. | _Asanivicakkaṁ_ is “forked lightning”, see Rig Veda 4.35.2 where _vicakra_ means “divided”.
